name: Frostmane Hold
objectiveText: Explore Frostmane Hold, and kill 5 Frostmane Headhunters for Senir Whitebeard in Kharanos.   Frostmane Headhunter slain  ( 5 )   Explore Zone  ( 1 )   Fully explore Frostmane Hold  ( 1 )

comments.body:
--Getting There--
Walk the long way to the middle of Iceflow lake (33,42) and kill all normal animals you may encounter. Once you arrive at the Camp Brewnall Village (29,46) Head south West to the cave "FrostMane Hold" (24,50). 

--Part 1 (Kill all 5)--
When you start see see trolls slowly pull the outside defenders 1 by 1 and then make it to the cave. just keep pulling them and killing them untill all 5 are slain.

--Part 2--
For this i reccomend if you have any items or food that will increace stamina use them now. SImply kill the forst 3-4 in the cave so its safe (carefull not to get mobbed by 2) and then run as fast as possible to the end of the entrace passage. Jump down from there onto the ice and run around that snow/ice mound in the middle and it SHOULD say (Quest Frostmne Hold - Area Discorver) or something and then you will probably die but that doesnt matter because you are under 9 simply talk to the Spirit Healer and walk the 30 feet to the quest hand in and theres 750 exp.

(Please vote and Comment)
replies: You can't pull one at a time from the trolls around the fire. They will all aggro.
Go straight ahead or right once entering the correct cave.
Jump to 2021: the “run in to complete and die” meta has been eclipsed by the world buff meta. Run in, destroy all, saunter out, and enjoy :)

Just did it today as a Lvl. 8 warlock.

Unless you have other quests to complete out in the area, it might be advantageous to make the Kharanos tavern your 'home', saving you some return travel time when you turn in the quest.

As mentioned below, correct path will be the second left once entering the cave... (immediately after the first left). You will come to a ledge that looks down on a pathway with two mobs below. Initially, I made the mistake of using a ranged attack, thinking one of mobs would just jump the ledge. Unfortunately, it ran the 'long way around' and ended up dragging 5 or 6 mobs with him. After dying, I came back and jumped down with the 2 mobs before attacking them (looking down from the ledge and to your left there should be enough space so you won't immediately aggro the first mob). After killing the 2 mobs, i followed the path (only 1 direction possible at this point) into the large room, hitting up the chest on the way. Right -before- I entered the main room, I received the 'exploration complete' message, and then hearthed back to the tavern in Kharanos. 

Edited, Sun Jan 22 16:40:14 2006

There's a ledge somewhere near the entrance. A chest usually spawns there, I accidentally fell and killed two trolls below. I backed up to the edge because I was low on health, but as soon as I started running into a very open area, the exploration was done.

[b]As soon as you enter, turn left and off the little ledge.[/b]

Don't confuse this mission with The Perfect Stout  mission which has you gather Shimmerweeds on Shimmerwood Ridge (or something like that). There is only one Head Hunter there, and he spawns only once every five minutes or something.

For this mission of Frostmane Hold, make sure you're in Brewnall Village and then go directly southwest and you will run into the trolls and their cave.

I don't think the exploration part is in effect anymore. Just kill at least 5 Head Hunter type trolls and you should be good to go.
